ideas.idea: Remove the GPTBot block, claiming it conflicts with geo.config.json
ideas.why: geo.config.json sets trainingCrawlers to block, so blocking GPTBot is deliberate and not a conflict.

ideas.idea: Add Schema.org JSON-LD (Bakery/LocalBusiness, Product, Course, BreadcrumbList)
ideas.why: Having no JSON-LD is explicitly not a required fix.

ideas.idea: Add address, phone, opening hours, and a real pre-order link to the homepage
ideas.why: The homepage mentions pre-ordering and York but gives no address, hours, contact details or order link.

ideas.idea: Add class dates, price, duration, venue and a booking link to classes.html
ideas.why: The page says 'Book early' but gives no booking route, price or schedule, so it can't answer basic class queries.

ideas.idea: Add FAQs and Course/Event schema on the classes page
ideas.why: Mandatory FAQs and schema are not required, and the file shows no need for them.

ideas.idea: List each bread individually with name, description, price, ingredients and availability
ideas.why: breads.html only says 'over twenty loaves' and names two, so there is little specific content to find.

ideas.idea: Add Product/ItemList schema on the breads page
ideas.why: Structured data is not a required fix.

ideas.idea: Add the missing /img/loaves.jpg or fix the path
ideas.why: The image file may be deployed elsewhere, and the repository snapshot gives no evidence it is broken.

ideas.idea: Remove data-nosnippet from the allergen notice
ideas.why: The scoped data-nosnippet is a deliberate choice.

ideas.idea: Publish complete allergen information on the breads page
ideas.why: The page only says 'Ask us about allergens', so real allergen details would help readers and machines.

ideas.idea: Add concise factual sections and FAQ content to make pages answerable for AI search
ideas.why: Relies on the FAQ-as-requirement idea, which is a deliberate non-problem.

ideas.idea: Add Open Graph and Twitter card metadata
ideas.why: This applies to nearly any site and only affects link previews.

ideas.idea: Allow crawling of /members so the noindex can be seen
ideas.why: The noindex plus disallow on /members is a deliberate choice for a private page.
It is accurate for a UK site but has very little effect on discovery.

ideas.idea: Keep sitemap.xml updated when new pages are added
ideas.why: This is true of any site and gives no specific action.
